rows.label: Quiet-machine K=4 projection

projection.method: Apply the independently measured chunk-256/TR=32 and fresh-prompt K=4 paired ratios to the last quiet 5.97 ms/token subgroup-32 result.
assumptions: The relative tuning and K=4 ratios persist once the unrelated ORCA workload ends.
The prompt/context distribution remains comparable to the measured short fresh-prompt corpus.
No claim is made that this is a direct quiet-machine timing.

rows.notes: Projection only. Do not present these values as measured.

publishedSubgroup32Quiet.notes: Last quiet direct timing before ORCA.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken while ORCA saturated the CPU. The paired ratio is the robust headline; quiet numbers remain a projection until directly rerun.
